## [Add]

- Add AlmaLinux 9 support to the MySQL, Percona, and GreatSQL deployment support matrix.
- Add AlmaLinux 9 package-resolution regression coverage for MySQL 5.7, 8.0, 8.4, and 9.7.

## [Change]

- Generalize MySQL 8.0.35+ and 8.4 package rules from Rocky9-specific handling to RHEL9-family handling so Rocky Linux 9 and AlmaLinux 9 use the glibc2.28 server packages.

## [Fix]

- Allow AlmaLinux9 targets through MySQL OS pre-checks and EL9 dependency fallbacks for MySQL 5.7 compatibility packages.
